'''Aratech''' was [[Star Galleon-class frigate|''Star Galleon''-class frigate]] of uncertain relation to the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|company]]. The ship was present at [[Calast]], a [[Golan Space Colony 2]] space station during the [[Rescue at Bundil II]], where it bore a shipment of firearms.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance" />
